reviews.review: Blood, gore and ridicolous amounts of violence. All in a day for a space marine. If you've ever had the dedire to play as a walking tank or demi-god, then this is the game for you. 40k fans would be rewarded by Relic's attention to detail but multiplayer has no dedicated servers so games might crash midway. If you can bear with that, then why not try it?

Unlike the strategy games of the 40k universe, this game truly captures how awesome it is to be a space marine. Be forewarned: this is a gorefest of chainsword ork-decapitating mayhem. If you enjoyed the sheer brutality and grit of the Gear of War franchise, then you will feel right at home with Space Marine. The camera perceptive and controls are similar. You can diveroll to avoid enemy blows and grenades. However, there is NO COVER system, which may take some getting used to. Even the level design is fairly open to force you out of hiding and into the fray. There is NO HEALTH REGENERATION (at least in the singleplayer) either; instead, you must eviscerate your enemies with a brutal melee finisher to regain health. Unfortunately, the game can get a little repetitive when you are using the same moves over and over in the same brown, drab environment, but the game does surprise you with some new, tougher enemies halfway through the game (I won't spoil it for you). Also, the multiplayer survival mode, Exterminatus, could use a few more maps. Fans of the 40k universe may be disappointed by the lack of certain weapons and armor sets (No terminator armor? No power fists? Dreadnoughts are DLC? Heresy, I say!) Overall, this is a well executed (pun intended) game with solid gameplay and an enjoyable multiplayer, offering a very satisfying (if at times simplified) Astartes experience.

Easily one of the best games I have played from steam. Has some flaws like bad checkpoint locations and mobs that corner you and explode, but working as intended.

One thing they do not advertise well is that "multiplayer" also includes 1 to 4 player coop. Whats important here is the 1 part. You can load a coop map by yourself and level alone if you cannot find coop partners. Its not the best idea, but its much better than coop dying once people move on.

I sat on this game for a long time having no idea how amazing it was. Very polished. Short of some collision detection implementation (mobs being pushed into walls or other objects) this game feels bug free so far. I have never once saw something that was game breaking, which is rare these days.

All the weapons are fun to use. All the environments are interesting and fairly detailed. Story is interesting with enough characters to enrich the experience.

If you have not tried this game, you should. If you are not into warhammer (im not) that will not have any impact on how awesome this game plays.
